description: Compare one financial metric or XBRL concept across ALL reporting companies for a CALENDAR period (SEC frames API), e.g. rank by revenue for CY2024, or compare specific companies. Pass metric (revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_basic, eps_diluted, operating_cash_flow, capex, total_assets, total_liabilities, stockholders_equity, cash, long_term_debt; aliases like sales, eps, assets) to fall back across the common tags for it (revenue: Revenues > RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax > SalesRevenueNet), with the tag used per company; or pass tag for one exact concept. Period: CY2024 (annual duration), CY2024Q2 (quarter), CY2024Q4I (instant, for balance-sheet items; added automatically for balance-sheet metrics). Calendar basis: each filer's ~1-year (or ~3-month) period that best fits the calendar period, so CY2024 for Microsoft is its fiscal year ending 2024-06-30 (flagged fiscal_period_differs); use get_financials for fiscal years. accn is the latest filing reporting the value. Pass companies to filter to specific tickers/CIKs (exact or prefix names also work, without typo correction; unresolved items are listed in `unresolved`); otherwise returns the top `limit` by value.

companies.description: Tickers or CIKs to include (default: all)

metric.description: Normalized metric with tag fallback, e.g. 'revenue', 'net_income', 'eps_diluted', 'total_assets'. Use instead of tag.

tag.description: Exact XBRL tag, e.g. 'Revenues', 'NetIncomeLoss', 'Assets' (case-sensitive). Use instead of metric.

unit.description: USD (default), USD-per-shares, shares, pure. With metric, defaults to the metric's unit

name: compare_companies
title: Cross-company comparison (XBRL frames)
